info.title: Kronan Public API
info.description:
Public API for Kronan SmartStore.

This API is designed for external systems, mobile apps, and third-party integrations to interact with the Kronan e-commerce platform.

This API is in BETA and in active development.

## Authentication
All endpoints require an `AccessToken` header: `Authorization: AccessToken <token>`.
Tokens are scoped to a user or a customer group.

Only Users with login type Audkenni can create access tokens.

Access tokens can be created in settings in User or Customer group pages.

## Available resources
- **Me** — Current authenticated identity
- **Addresses** — Shipping addresses for the authenticated user or customer group
- **Slots** — Available delivery and pickup time slots
- **Products** — Browse products, search in smart store product selection, view details, list products on sale, and list favorites
- **Categories** — Category tree and paginated product listings
- **Orders** — Order history, details, and line modifications
- **Checkout** — Smart checkout with line management
- **Shopping Notes** — Freeform shopping lists with product linking, plus Scan & Go product lookup and in-store search
- **Recipes** — Browse recipes, search by tags, view ingredients with availability, manage favorites
- **Product Lists** — Saved product collections
- **Purchase Stats** — Personal purchase history and frequency data
- **Order Line Summary** — Monthly spend and quantity totals for historical products

## Coming soon
- Payment initiation with gift cards as we can't integrate with 3DS programmatically
- Scoped access tokens — create tokens restricted to specific actions (e.g. a token that can only add items to checkout)

## Rate limiting
All endpoints are rate limited to 200 requests per 200 seconds per user. Exceeding the limit returns `429 Too Many Requests`.

## Conventions
- All monetary values are integers (ISK, no decimals)
- Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC with trailing `Z`
- Empty arrays return `[]`, never `null`
- Paginated endpoints use either `limit`/`offset` or page-based pagination, depending on the endpoint
- Response field names are `snake_case`

get.description:
Base viewset for all public API endpoints.

AccessTokenAuthentication validates the token, user, and expiry.
IsAuthenticated rejects requests with no token at all.

Returns monthly spend and quantity totals for fulfilled historical order lines belonging to the authenticated user or customer group. Match either a literal case-insensitive substring of the historical product name or up to 10 exact SKUs. Amounts use final fulfilled quantities, including substitutions actually received; products the picking system never picked are excluded. Fee, shipping, service and donation lines are matchable like any other line, so they are only counted when the query matches them. This is an order-line summary, not payment settlement or refund accounting. Matched products are grouped by historical SKU and use the newest matched line name; at most 25 are listed, while matched_product_count reports how many matched in total. Ranges containing more than 750 fulfilled orders must be narrowed.

parameters.name: from_month
parameters.description: Calendar month (1-12) of the first month in the range.

parameters.name: from_year
parameters.description: Calendar year of the first month in the range. Supply together with from_month, to_year and to_month, or omit all four for the trailing 12 months.

parameters.name: name_contains
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring to match against the historical order-line product name. Mutually exclusive with skus.

parameters.name: skus
parameters.description: One or more exact historical order-line SKUs. Supply as repeated query parameters or one comma-separated parameter. Mutually exclusive with name_contains.

parameters.name: to_month
parameters.description: Calendar month (1-12) of the last month in the range. The range end cannot be later than the current month.

parameters.name: to_year
parameters.description: Calendar year of the last month in the range.

Returns a paginated list of products that currently have an active sale and are available for home delivery from the identity's picking stores, ordered by popularity.

Previously purchased products are moved to the front, most recently purchased first, for identities that have accepted the data policy when the access token has the `can_view_purchase_history` permission.

get.description:
OpenApi3 schema for this API. Format can be selected via content negotiation.

- YAML: application/vnd.oai.openapi
- JSON: application/vnd.oai.openapi+json
Returns the shopping note for the authenticated user or customer group. Auto-creates one if none exists.

post.description: Add a new line to the shopping note. Provide either a `text` (freeform item) or a `sku` (linked product), with an optional quantity.
Add multiple lines at once. Each line must have either text or SKU, not both. Maximum 30 lines per request. Returns the updated shopping note.

patch.description: Update the text or quantity of an existing shopping note line. If neither text nor quantity is provided, the line is deleted.
Change the display order of lines by passing their tokens in the desired order via `lines_tokens` query parameter.

delete.description: Remove a line from the shopping note by its token.
Remove a specific archived line by its token. Returns the remaining archived lines.
Delete all lines from the shopping note (the note itself is preserved).

get.description: Check if the shopping note contains products that can be ordered from a store. Returns 204 if eligible, 404 if no matching products found.
Returns previously completed and archived shopping note lines.
Returns product details for use in Scan & Go shopping notes. Provide either `sku` or `barcode` as a query parameter. The barcode is resolved to a SKU via the barcode service.
get.summary: Look up product by SKU or barcode

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: Product barcode. Either sku or barcode must be provided.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Product SKU. Either sku or barcode must be provided.

get.description: Returns available Scan & Go stores. Use the `ext_id` value as the `store` parameter in the search endpoint.

post.description: Search for products available in a specific Scan & Go store. Unlike the general product search which searches products available for home delivery, this searches the in-store product selection — including products that are only sold in-store and not available online. Use GET /shopping-notes/scan-n-go-stores/ to list available store ext_ids.
Reorder shopping note lines to match the store's product aisle layout for efficient in-store shopping.

patch.description: Mark a shopping note line as completed or uncompleted.

addressId.description: ID of the delivery address. Must belong to the authenticated user/group.

substitution.description: Whether substitution is allowed if this product is unavailable.

replace.description: If true, replaces all existing checkout lines. If false, adds to existing lines.

quantity.description: New total quantity for the lines. Must be lower than current quantity. Set to 0 to remove.

PublicOrder.description: Full order representation with lines for detail/mutation endpoints.

allowAlterOrderLines.description: Whether the customer can still modify or remove lines from this order.

deliveryInfo.description: Delivery details for upcoming home delivery orders. Null for non-delivery orders or past deliveries.

substitutionForLineId.description: ID of the original line this line substitutes for, or null.

isMutable.description: Whether this line can be modified or deleted.

PublicOrderSummary.description: Lightweight order representation for list endpoints.

allowAlterOrderLines.description: Whether the customer can still modify or remove lines from this order.

deliveryInfo.description: Delivery details for upcoming home delivery orders. Null for non-delivery orders or past deliveries.

PublicProduct.description: Standard product representation used across list/search/category endpoints.

PublicProductDetail.description: Extended product representation with description, full image, and tags.

PublicProductListWithCount.description: Used in list endpoint where has_products is annotated on the queryset.

tags.description: Filter by tag IDs. Available IDs are returned in the search response's available_tags.

withDetail.description: If true, each hit includes discounted price, discount percent, and tags. Slower.

includePurchaseHistory.description: If true, each hit includes the authenticated user or customer group's purchase stats when available.

text.description: Freeform text for the line. Either text or sku must be provided.

sku.description: Product SKU to link. Either sku or text must be provided.

store.description: Scan & Go store ext_id. Use GET /shopping-notes/scan-n-go-stores/ to list available stores.

availabilityStatus.description: Remaining slot capacity. 0 = fully booked, -1 = unlimited.
